firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a reptile goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: That player takes the starting marker. Initial scores are assigned according to the resulting clockwise player order.
